description: Google search volume, CPC, competition, keyword difficulty and intent for up to 20 comma-separated keywords in one $0.04 GET (Google Ads data). Use when you need monthly search volume for a few keywords in a country. volume = avg monthly searches, cpc in USD, competition 0-1, difficulty 0-100. Up to 100 keywords for the same $0.04: POST /v1/keyword-overview. Keywords without data are listed in missing (still charged). Bad input is free; upstream errors are not charged. Price: $0.04 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of a supported location (us, gb, de, ...; uk = gb). Default us.

includeMonthly.description: Add each keyword's monthly search volumes.

keywords.description: 1-20 keywords (no commas inside a keyword; each at most 80 characters). Whitespace and control characters are normalised to single spaces and keywords to lower case; a keyword that is then empty, over 10 words or over 80 characters is not looked up and is listed in missing; none left to look up is a free 400.

lang.description: Language code offered for the country (en, es, de, ...). Default en when offered.

name: keyword_search_volume
title: Search volume (GET, up to 20 keywords)
